title: Strata fixture profile (fixtures/<profile>.yaml)
description: What each DMX channel of each mode drives. Usually generated by strata fixture import from Open Fixture Library JSON. The engine also rejects a mode where two channels drive the same attribute of the same pixel.

source.description: Where the channel layout comes from, typically the manual's URL.

channels.description: In DMX order: the first channel is at the fixture's start address.

attribute.description: What the engine drives. A channel without one holds its default.

pixel.description: For colour attributes, the 1-based pixel (segment). Defaults to 1.
